description: First jump is hold-sensitive; double jump is fixed.

firstJump.onPress: Start ascending toward max height (same max as before: ~1/2 screen).
firstJump.onRelease: Begin falling immediately when the player lifts their finger, even if max height was not reached.
firstJump.ifHeld: Continue rising until max height, then fall normally.
firstJump.airTimeNote: Original ~3s air time applies when held to full height; early release shortens air time.

secondJump.note: Unchanged from original design. Tap in air for double jump (~3/4 screen). Adds ~2s air time from when pressed. Not hold-sensitive.
secondJump.onRelease: No effect on double jump arc.
